name: nft-drop-then-accept
description: drop precedes accept; same two rules as the accept-then-drop case, opposite order
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
